about: How scripts/friction.py recognises a turn spent fighting the factory's own code (FR-55). Closed variety: the spellings OUR scripts, hooks and validators use when they refuse a call (FR-13). Read by code, judged by nobody: a spelling this file does not hold is not counted, so the retro says 'friction' only for what it can name. traceback, guard_markers and validator_head_phrases are matched against the lower-cased result text; stand_markers and usage_regex against the original text.
